purpose: Teach: 苦しめ/多量/容姿/昼過ぎ/晴天/言わば/手渡し/向っ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが家族を苦しめないようご苦労された
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, Father was careful not to burden the family.
lines.style: Soft, remembering gaze. Gentle opening. Speaking more to the memory than to her. Pace steady but tender. Weight of affection in each phrase.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、多量の野菜を畑から運ばれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and he'd carry so many vegetables from the garden for us, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm affirmation, eyes lighting up. Quick, alive recall. Slight emphasis on "so many" — a small laugh in it. Reaching back into shared history.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは人の容姿より中身を見られた
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, Father saw what was inside people, not just what they looked like.
lines.style: Quiet conviction underneath. Pause before "inside" — like this matters. Slow, deliberate pacing. Voice settling deeper into respect.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、昼過ぎにお茶を飲まれるのが日課だったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And he'd always have his tea in the afternoon — such a steady habit of his, wasn't it, dear?
lines.style: Gentle amusement in the voice. Rhythm of daily routine, almost lilting. Tender correction or completion, like she's adding her piece to his memory. Slight nod in the tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、晴天の日は必ず散歩された
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, on clear days he would always go for a walk.
lines.style: Simple, observant tone. No embellishment — just stating what was. Slight pause before "always." Soft trailing off, like watching him leave.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、言わば家の大黒柱でいらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And he was the pillar of our home, wasn't he, dear? Always there, holding everything together.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. Warm, almost protective in the delivery. Slight rise on "pillar" — acknowledging his strength. Soft, grounded finish.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが手紙を手渡しで届けられた
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, Father would deliver letters by hand.
lines.style: Specific, admiring detail. Thoughtful pacing — each word chosen with care. Slight emphasis on "by hand" — the personal touch mattering. Wistful trailing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、故郷に向って手を合わせられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And he'd face toward his hometown and pray, hands pressed together — such devotion he had, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Reverent, almost hushed. Gentle, intimate pacing. Slight tremor of emotion beneath. Closes on tenderness, seeking her agreement like a shared blessing.
